title: Native Windows lab provisioning
summary: The native Windows lab adapter uses Windows OpenSSH and PowerShell, an interactive scheduled task for desktop screenshots and console checks, profile goldens that preserve live identities, and a lease-bound machine-settings recovery journal. Standard-user task control uses native Task Scheduler COM; protected SYSTEM receipts provide current-lease Windows feature evidence. SSH is key-only from any address. Human RDP is allowed over verified Tailscale self addresses or adapters, never the public internet; an SSH forward remains available for bootstrap. Provisioning and live restoration require separate machine receipts before readiness is claimed.
